version: tier_prices v1.0 2026-11-08 (DRAFT for Jonathan's review; every input is a working assumption pending citation)

human_cost.note: C_H = minutes / 60 * loaded hourly rate. Minutes = time to do the task by hand (CPOE time-and-motion, to cite). Rate = junior doctor / medical officer, the grade that enters inpatient orders (MOH/MOM salary bands, to cite); 110 (registrar) and 165 (consultant) are sensitivity values, not used by the trainer.

failure_cost.note: C_F = rework + p_slip * p_event * cost_of_event. rework = rework_multiplier * C_H (pharmacist query -> cancel -> re-order). p_slip = wrong order passes pharmacist verification and nurse administration check. p_event = share of slipped errors counted as an incident. cost_of_event = sum of the listed components. Same assumptions for both task types (decided 8 Nov: the safety literature does not rank oral potassium above IV magnesium).

operating.label: every slipped error is a reportable incident (operating price, decided 8 Nov)
